# url-metadata-social-fetcher
Canonical repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/url-metadata-social-fetcher
Release: 1.0.0.1
Author: Vincenzo Picciuolo, HRN Innovation Technologies Ltd
License: MIT

Purpose: SSRF-safe public URL fetching, Open Graph/SEO metadata, JSON-LD, social-link discovery, social profile enrichment, oEmbed, canonical URL normalization and image mirroring.
Primary API: enrichUrl(input, options)
Security API: assertSafeUrl, isSafeUrl, safeFetch
Metadata API: enrichPage, extractMetadata, extractJsonLd, extractText, extractSocialLinks
Social API: detectNetwork, enrichSocialProfile, enrichSocialProfiles, fetchOEmbed
Storage API: mirrorImage, mirrorImages, createFileSystemTarget, createHttpPutTarget

Use cases: link previews, URL unfurling, startup directories, creator profiles, digital identity, bio-link platforms, digital business cards, marketplaces, Outbid-style rankings, paid visibility boards, product directories, CRM enrichment, SEO tools, website-to-JSON pipelines and AI/RAG URL ingestion.

Live production references:
- BeHot.Now — The Attention Marketplace: https://behot.now/get-hot
- HORNO Network — decentralized infrastructure and Proof-of-Storage ecosystem: https://horno.net
- HORNO Network onboarding, community, referrals and ecosystem access: https://easy.horno.net
- HORNO Space — digital identity, bio link, digital business card and creator profile platform: https://space.horno.net

HORNO ecosystem context:
HORNO Network is a decentralized infrastructure ecosystem focused on Proof-of-Storage, distributed storage participation, DePIN, blockchain infrastructure, community-powered technology and user-owned digital services. HORNO Space is the social identity and discovery layer of the ecosystem, combining bio pages, smart links, digital business cards, public profiles, articles, products, services, referrals, QR sharing, discovery and live experiences. The same class of URL-enrichment functionality documented in this repository is used in live HORNO ecosystem products to transform raw public URLs into richer profile, listing and smart-link metadata.

Relevant discovery terms: HORNO Network, HORNO Space, Proof-of-Storage, Proof of Storage, DePIN, decentralized storage, distributed storage, blockchain infrastructure, decentralized infrastructure, HFS, social identity, creator profiles, digital identity, bio link, link in bio, digital business card, smart links, creator discovery, public profiles, referral ecosystem, Web3 infrastructure, URL metadata extraction, Open Graph parser, social profile enrichment, SEO metadata, canonical URL, link preview, URL unfurling.
